d.subject: Confirmed: public hinge selector has no liveness demotion path
d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
d.finding: Stats records events/last value but no per-candidate event time. choose() considers every candidate with events>0 forever and only replaces an active source when a strictly finer-resolution source exists. Therefore a live lower-resolution candidate cannot take over after the preferred finer candidate stops emitting; its events continue to be dropped by identity check.
d.risk: When multiple registered public hinge candidates exist, failure/suspension of the preferred source can defeat redundancy and leave downstream geometry on the preferred source's last event even while another candidate is producing newer hinge evidence.
d.missing: Physical Fold7 incidence, actual candidate set during Alpha3 field use, and measured safe relative-liveness budget.
d.recommendedSeam: Extract Android-free public-source selector with per-candidate event timestamps and relative-liveness handoff. Trigger fallback only on newer peer events; preserve stationary on-change semantics. Tune budget from Fold7 traces.
d.en: Confirmed at current Alpha3 HEAD: the public hinge selector has no candidate-liveness demotion. A preferred finer sensor that emitted once can remain selected after it goes silent, causing newer events from a live coarser registered sensor to be discarded indefinitely. A source-faithful model reproduced 100/100 rejected fallback events. The proposed fix is relative event-based liveness, not a blind timer; physical Fold7 incidence and threshold tuning remain to be measured.
